verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs list a dedicated 'Content variants' feature for managing multiple versions of a site's content (e.g., API versions), which matches the versioning/switching story, but the evidence pack only shows the docs page title with no detail on the reader-facing switcher UI, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of how version switching works in practice. missing for 10: detailed description of the version-switcher UX, independent/hands-on validation, confirmation of per-version URLs or SEO handling.
